hero.tagline: A hidden local ski area with perfect powder and private night skiing, located in the mysterious village of Shingo.

sanctuary.title:
Shade bowl terrain
keeps miracle snow.
sanctuary.lead: One rope tow, 120–200 m runs in a village-run bowl. Built to avoid direct sun, snow holds well—often untouched ungroomed powder. When few visit, staff may start the tow just for you. Warm, deeply local hospitality.
sanctuary.noticeBody: Mountain roads off Route 454 may close in blizzards. Do not rely on car nav alone—call Shingo Village (0178-78-2111) for snow and opening status. No cafeteria or rentals on site.
sanctuary.imgAlt: Night-lit secret bowl—quiet Shingo village snow

primary.title: Ops status × snowfall API
primary.lead: "No visitors, no staff"—disclosed honestly on a live LP dashboard (plan). Cut the risk of driving out and finding closed runs; build trust with powder hunters.
primary.imgAlt: Untouched powder on a quiet village bowl

secondary.title: Free hidden gem
secondary.lead: Village-run and free. Skip mega-resort crowds—no-track ungroomed powder and near-private sessions. Inconvenience becomes the value.

pass.title:
Free—your ticket
to secret powder.
pass.lead: Rent a car at Morioka or Hachinohe and head north on Route 454 to Shingo's secret bowl. Admission is free—leave a coffee-sized donation after your runs (plan): QR plus physical box.
pass.imgAlt: Snowy Route 454—winter road toward Shingo village

hike.title:
Cross winter roads
to the secret bowl.
hike.lead: About 45–60 minutes by car from Hachinohe Station. Public transit is effectively impossible—Route 454 is the lifeline. Nav apps may mislead; check access videos and maps first.
hike.leadCurry: After runs, Shingo Onsen (Washi-no-Yu) or Ebisuya Christ Ramen—extend your stay with area loops, not the hill alone.
hike.imgAlt: Route 454 in deep snow—mountain road to the hills

tour.title:
Mystery & powder,
one-day retreat.
tour.lead: Christ's Tomb and secret powder in one day—a deep Shingo loop that turns inconvenience into the story (plan).

sanctuary.title: Secret bowl complete guide
sanctuary.body: One rope tow, bowl-shaped ungroomed terrain, free admission. Also a local racing team training hill—a phantom local gem known only to insiders.

workation.title: Live ops disclosure plan
workation.body: Post weekend opening, night skiing, and snow status each morning on X and the LP dashboard (plan). Reduce "drove out for nothing" anxiety for distant visitors.

lake.title: Mystery × powder corridor
lake.body: Christ's Tomb, Oishigami Pyramid, Ogata horse-meat sakura nabe—link Shingo with Gonohe and Towada in a 2-night model. Free skiing as the hook for regional spend.

access.note: ~45–60 min by car from Hachinohe Sta. · via Route 454 · winter closures possible
